title: Replace root apm.yml and install skill-level apm.yml
description: Use git mv to move the existing root apm.yml to .apm/skills/skill-memory/apm.yml (preserving git history). Then create a new root apm.yml as the repo-level manifest with name, version, description, author, empty dependencies/scripts, and a compilation.exclude section listing specs/**, tests/**, .takt/**, .claude/**, .agents/**, templates/**, docs/**.
acceptance_criteria: Root apm.yml exists and contains a compilation.exclude section
Root apm.yml compilation.exclude covers: specs/**, tests/**, .takt/**, .claude/**, .agents/**, templates/**, docs/**
Root apm.yml has name: skill-memory and version: 0.1.0
